mapper.select: select r.id as id, r.name as name, r.description as description from t_user_roles ur join t_role r on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and ur.delete_time is null

select pr.descendant_id from t_user_roles ur join t_role_permissions rp on ur.role_id = rp.role_id join t_permission_relationships pr on rp.permission_id = pr.ancestor_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and ur.delete_time is null
